levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-produc.description: Evaluates new product opportunities through demand, channels and economics before committing to build.
Defines product requirements, business rules and acceptance criteria for a committed intent; edits product docs only.
Designs user flows, interaction states and mockups for a defined product scope; does not implement UI code.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-archit.description: Defines measurable architecture drivers and constraints before system design; edits architecture docs only.
Documents current architecture from implementation evidence; does not propose a target or audit fitness.
Designs target system boundaries, contracts and tradeoffs from requirements; does not plan tasks or implement.
Records one architecture decision with alternatives, consequences and status; does not design the whole system.
Creates evidence-backed current or target architecture diagrams; not UI design.
Plans architecture migrations with compatibility, data safety, rollout and recovery; does not execute them.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-delive.description: Builds dependency-ordered delivery plans from requirements and repository evidence; read-only.
Plans risk-based test portfolios and acceptance evidence; does not write or execute tests.
Reviews a concrete implementation plan for missing decisions, feasibility and risk before execution; read-only.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-implem.description: Implements one scoped product feature or fix using existing contracts; not upgrades, performance tuning or establishing cross-cutting technical foundations.
Upgrades dependencies in reversible batches with version-specific compatibility and regression checks.
Modernizes a bounded capability to reduce demonstrated maintenance cost; not routine upgrades or performance tuning.
Profiles and improves a measured performance bottleneck; retains only verified improvements.
Compares tools or implementations through controlled benchmarks and independent correctness checks.
Configures and verifies lint, type, architecture and other engineering checks; not product cleanup, policy invention or deployment redesign.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-qualit.description: Builds, updates or retires scoped acceptance tests and verifies execution; does not repair product code.
Reviews a completed change for acceptance, regressions and release risk; read-only, not a whole-codebase audit.
Audits documentation and comments for trust, coverage, consistency and freshness; read-only.
Audits cross-cutting codebase health, security and maintainability; not a single-change review or specialist audit.
Audits existing tests for risk coverage, reliable oracles and maintenance value; does not edit tests.
Audits implemented architecture boundaries, dependencies and ownership; not target design or plan review.
Audits queries, transactions, consistency and persistence resource lifetimes; read-only.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-delive.description: Commits, pushes and remotely verifies authorized repository changes; does not create releases.
Prepares and publishes an explicitly requested tagged GitHub release; does not deploy applications.
Prepares delivery pipelines and remote infrastructure, then executes authorized rollouts; not standalone quality-gate setup or local container packaging.
Drafts or publishes authorized, fact-checked GitHub Discussions announcements; does not create releases.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-operat.description: Diagnoses incidents from operational evidence and proposes recovery; does not change live systems.
Evaluates observed product outcomes against a prior hypothesis; does not run experiments or change user treatment.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-skill-.description: Reviews skill instructions, trigger boundaries and distribution contracts; not product code.

levnikolaevich-claude-code-skills-engine.description: Creates project technical rules and recurring local procedures from the actual stack; edits guidance only, not architecture targets or application code.
Builds, hardens or reviews container images and local runtime packaging with startup and shutdown evidence; not remote deployment or host administration.
Establishes configuration ownership, validation, secret boundaries and environment isolation; not credential identity policy or live deployment.
Implements or repairs identity verification and session or credential lifecycle; not operation permissions, resource access policy or a new identity provider by default.
Implements permissions and tenant or owner scoped resource access while preserving approved grants; not authentication or role redesign.
Implements safe error boundaries, cancellation and user recovery contracts; not telemetry pipelines or durable retry machinery.
Implements structured diagnostics, correlation and justified metrics or traces; not incident investigation or a mandatory telemetry platform.
Implements transactions, idempotency and interrupted-operation recovery; not schema migration or a mandatory background-job platform.
Prepares and verifies schema migrations, database roles and isolated recovery or test resources; not query tuning or runtime mutation orchestration.
